offence: Unlicensed moneylending (contravenes or assists in contravention of the prohibition on carrying on moneylending except under licence / excluded / exempt)
arrestText: May arrest without warrant (expressly arrestable and non-bailable under MA s.86 — no in-view limit; overrides CPC term defaults)
punishment: Individual 1st: fine $30,000-$300,000 and imprisonment not exceeding 4 years; also liable to caning not more than 6 strokes (higher mandatory strokes if damage or hurt caused). Subsequent: fine $30,000-$300,000 and imprisonment not exceeding 7 years. Body corporate: fine $50,000-$500,000

offence: Harassment on behalf of unlicensed moneylender
arrestText: May arrest without warrant (expressly arrestable and non-bailable under MA s.86 — no in-view limit; overrides CPC term defaults)
punishment: Imprisonment up to 5 years and fine $5,000-$50,000; caning (minimum applies if damage caused)

offence: Abetment of s.47 (instructions, transport, lookout, or verifying a s.47(1) act)
arrestText: s.86 expressly deems only s.19 and s.47 arrestable and non-bailable. Abetment of s.47 is punishable under PC Chapter 5 — confirm on SSO
bailText: Check Act (s.86 names s.19 and s.47 only)
punishment: Punishable as abetment of s.47 under Penal Code Chapter 5 — see Act
